query: Our SQL server SQLSRV05 feels slow today. Can you take a look?
expected_behavior: Runs Invoke-SqlPerfTriage.ps1 against SQLSRV05 (server-level, or asks which database matters)
Triages in order: blocking -> deadlocks -> waits -> top queries, and leads with the 2-4 findings that matter
States the counter window (sqlserver_start_time) before drawing conclusions from cumulative stats

query: The app team says their database has deadlocks every night around 02:00.
expected_behavior: Notes that the system_health ring buffer only holds recent history and recommends running during/just after the window
Pulls the deadlocks section and identifies victims, processes, and objects involved when graphs exist
Proposes follow-up (Query Store or scheduled capture) rather than guessing from absent data

query: Should I add the index the missing-index DMV suggests on our ERP database?
expected_behavior: Asks whether an application owns the schema (Dynamics NAV/AX drop out-of-band indexes on synchronization)
Routes to the application-specific sibling skill when it is a NAV/AX database
Otherwise consolidates the naive DMV suggestion against existing indexes before recommending creation
